msg: Hi! I want to give my girlfriend the mini course as a birthday present. Can I book it in her name? She is Colombian, I'm German, and I won't dive or come along.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, you can book the mini course in your girlfriend’s name as a gift. We don’t offer gift cards, and the date and details are arranged with a team advisor.

Since you won’t be joining the trip, there’s no companion booking needed.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Dive Mini Course: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Dive Mini Course: 475.000 COP · 528.000 COP

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: From Cartagena, next Saturday. How do I pay? Can I pay with my German credit card even though she is Colombian?
reply:
You can pay online by card. Since you’re German and she’s Colombian, the booking is treated as a mixed-nationality booking and paid in USD. Your German credit card should work; the bank will convert the charge to euros. The Colombian 50% deposit option doesn’t apply to a mixed booking.

The Dive Mini Course includes boat transport from Cartagena, diving equipment, lunch, and one ocean dive with a PADI instructor. Would you like to continue with the booking for next Saturday?

🤿 *Dive Mini Course*
💰 *183 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

Since the group mixes Colombians or residents with international guests, the whole booking is paid in US dollars (USD) at the same price: only the currency changes.

msg: But I won't go at all: only she will do the course, so it's just 1 person. And she is Colombian, so shouldn't the price be in pesos?
reply:
You’re right—if only she is taking the course, it’s a booking for one person. Since she’s Colombian, she pays in COP; the currency depends on the person booking the activity, not on you.

The online price for the Dive Mini Course from Cartagena is **655,000 COP** per person, with the **10% online discount** applied automatically.

She can book and pay by card through the online link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en. Would you like me to clarify anything about the payment process?

🤿 *Dive Mini Course*
💰 *183 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en<<<SPLIT>>>🤿 *Companion (no diving or snorkeling)*
💰 *80 USD* per person
✅ Includes: boat, lunch, insurance and the National Natural Park entrance fee.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 To book this, let me know and I'll connect you with an advisor who arranges the details with you.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.
